title: ABBACompatibilityBindingMap
rule: Existing substrate implementations are reusable bindings, not semantic authority.

bindings.authority: tool trace; capability and authority remain separate
execution remains subject to authority/policy gate
control configuration is subordinate to Canon and explicit authority

bindings.integrationRole: existing append-only event projection and canonical-event adapter ingress
bindings.authority: event semantics must remain aligned with Carbon Actual canonical event contract
bindings.notes: Canonical Event Envelope is adapted into the existing omnii_events substrate; no production canonical_events table is introduced.

bindings.authority: derived current state, not historical event stream
reconciliation outcome is evidence/analysis, not authority

integrationRules: Do not rename or delete existing substrate tables merely to make names look canonical.
Do not duplicate an existing live capability when a compatible adapter can bind it.
Do not treat an existing omnii-prefixed table as constitutional authority.
All consequential mutations introduced through the new Carbon Actual canonical runtime must retain principal, authority, policy, provenance, correlation and idempotency.
Historical provenance is preserved through bindings rather than rewritten.

Production canonical event binding uses public.omnii_append_event; append_canonical_event(jsonb) remains a staged canonical-contract interface until the existing substrate mapping is promoted through controlled deployment.
Never introduce a duplicate production canonical_events table solely to satisfy a contract name when an existing append-only event substrate can be adapted.
